<MethodEndpoint
  method={"get"}
  path={"/api/v1.0/filters/for/entitytype/{entityTypeId}"}
  context={"endpoint"}
>
  
</MethodEndpoint>



Returns all filter definitions (facets) that can be applied when searching for the specified entity type.

**Filter Metadata:**
- Facet key
- UI label
- Category
- Filter control type

Combine this endpoint with [GET /api/v1.0/categories/of/filters](/docs/api/categories/list-filter-categories) to present filters grouped by category before constructing search payloads.
